books *first*
slides.body: five reasons georgia is a great first solo trip. save this post.

slides.head: why women travel here *alone*
slides.body: crime is low, prices are tiny - and solo guests get adopted. the guesthouse grandma will feed you khachapuri and wait up for you.

slides.head: the old town fits in *one walk*
slides.body: carved balconies, cobblestones and steaming sulfur domes. pushkin bathed here and called it the best bath of his life.

slides.head: the best *view*
slides.body: ride the cable car up to narikala fortress - the whole city under your feet. grab warm shoti bread from a bakery on the way down.

slides.head: a tip most people *miss*
slides.body: skip taxis, the metro costs cents. and eat khinkali like a local: hold the topknot, never use a knife.

slides.head: one *easy* day trip
slides.body: mtskheta is 30 minutes away - ancient churches and amber wine from clay qvevri jars. georgians have made wine for 8,000 years.

slides.lead: five simple tips. one easier trip.
